svg.title: How Retake works
svg.desc: You watch v4, press R, talk and draw three notes over the video, and press Send. One agent on your computer edits the project files (the timeline, code, whatever format the project uses), the renderer redraws only the parts of the video those edits changed, and each note turns done as its change lands in v5.
svg.text: Talk and draw. Get the next version.
